description: A retrieval.reindex (or graph.build, graph.reparse, graph.delete) on a connection the daemon cannot attribute to a lawful person refuses with the platform operation's no-actor code (S54 T1, the -31956 — re-anchored in build when S60's block took -31952...-31955 on main first): the actor comes from the connection (the daemon's ActorFor seam), never from params, and an unresolvable, empty or uid-0 peer id — or an actor kind the platform audit cannot name — is refused rather than stamped with a placeholder (SP3 admits 'user' and 'cli' only; no agent reaches these doors, SP4). Nothing was queued, no rows were touched, and no platform_change row exists; the derived index stays exactly as it was. The registry's own sentence rides, unfilled by any handler.

error.message: no person at the endpoint for this platform operation

data.what: retrieval.reindex, graph.build, graph.reparse or graph.delete reached its door without a lawful human actor: no stamping source on the table, an empty or uid-0 peer id, or an actor kind the platform audit cannot name (SP3 admits 'user' and 'cli' only)
